<thought>We need the precursors obtained by applying retrosynthetic template 1914391 to the target molecule(s) provided. First, retrieve the template to see its SMARTS, then check which of the two SMILES from the previous step matches the template. If a match is found, apply the template to get precursor combinations. Finally, format the result as a list of lists of SMILES strings.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
